title: Context window as routed fact and pre-dispatch sizing policy (Story 1.5, lane A)
summary: First of four lanes implementing the frozen Story 1.5 in the kit's dispatch adapter: resolve the routed profile's context window from the stamp plus the trusted catalog as a read-only fact (NOT_EVALUATED when undeclared), compute a deterministic documented pre-dispatch sizing estimate of the worker payload, declare thresholds and reason codes in a machine-readable launcher policy file, refuse dispatch fail-closed before placement when the estimate is past the continuation threshold, record a sizing-risk finding otherwise, expose a budget member in the thin result, and add contract, schema and skill documentation plus pure and stubbed-integration tests on both launch classes and both harnesses. No change to route requests, stamps, the validator, or the frozen launch command texts. Judgment calls: estimate input enumeration, refusal ordering, record-append idempotence. A wrong result means false refusals or missed refusals in the dispatch path; no credentials are handled.
